pharedesbaleines.name: Phare des Baleines
pharedesbaleines.slogan: 257 spiral steps to the end of Île de Ré.
pharedesbaleines.line: The 57-metre lighthouse opened in 1854; Vauban's 1682 tower still stands 80 metres away.

larochelletoursaintnicolas.name: Tour Saint-Nicolas
larochelletoursaintnicolas.slogan: A medieval gatekeeper standing guard over the Old Port.
larochelletoursaintnicolas.line: Built from 1384, it is one of three medieval towers guarding La Rochelle's port, and rises about 42 metres.

saintmartinvauban.name: Saint-Martin-de-Ré Ramparts
saintmartinvauban.slogan: Vauban's star-shaped walls around a tiny island harbour.
saintmartinvauban.line: Vauban's fortifications of Saint-Martin joined the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2008.

rochefortcorderie.name: Corderie Royale
rochefortcorderie.slogan: A rope factory as long as four football pitches.
rochefortcorderie.line: The Corderie is over 374 metres long and made rigging for the French Navy until 1867.

larochelleaquarium.name: La Rochelle Aquarium
larochelleaquarium.slogan: Sharks and 600 species, a stone's throw from the Old Port.
larochelleaquarium.line: Three million litres of seawater hold over 12,000 animals, with around 800,000 visitors a year.
